label: Bible Study
prompt: And Samson called unto the LORD, and said, O Lord GOD, remember me, I pray thee, and _____ me, I pray thee, only this once, O God, that I may be at once avenged of the Philistines for my two eyes.
verse: And Samson called unto the LORD, and said, O Lord GOD, remember me, I pray thee, and strengthen me, I pray thee, only this once, O God, that I may be at once avenged of the Philistines for my two eyes.
note: Samson's last prayer, in the temple of Dagon — eyes gone, hair growing back, one more push left.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And it came to pass in the mean while, that the heaven was black with clouds and wind, and there was a great _____. And Ahab rode, and went to Jezreel.
verse: And it came to pass in the mean while, that the heaven was black with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. And Ahab rode, and went to Jezreel.
note: After a long drought and seven trips to look for a cloud, there was a great rain.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the _____, which the LORD God had taken from man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man.
verse: And the rib, which the LORD God had taken from man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man.
note: From one rib, a whole woman — and Adam's first recorded words are a delighted 'bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: Then we which are alive and remain shall be _____ up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.
verse: Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.
note: The meeting in the air — and Paul saves the best line for last: 'so shall we ever be with the Lord.'

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Thou tellest my _____: put thou my tears into thy bottle: are they not in thy book?
verse: Thou tellest my wanderings: put thou my tears into thy bottle: are they not in thy book?
note: God tallies every one of David's 'wanderings' and keeps his tears in a bottle — the most tender filing system in Scripture.
